cards.card_text: While Nehemiah mourns, he's fasting and ___ before the God of heaven.
cards.verse_text: I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.
cards.snippet: I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

cards.card_text: Now, on the twenty-fourth day of that same month, the Israelites gather again, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.
cards.verse_text: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.
cards.snippet: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth, with dust on their heads.

cards.card_text: When those same people were ill, David put on sackcloth and humbled himself with fasting.
cards.verse_text: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
cards.snippet: …when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.

cards.card_text: David says he's fading away like a lengthening shadow, his knees weak from fasting, his body lean and gaunt.
cards.verse_text: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
cards.snippet: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.

cards.card_text: The king goes back to his palace and spends the night fasting, and sleep flees from him.
cards.verse_text: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting.
cards.snippet: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting.

cards.card_text: Fasting with sackcloth and ashes A feast with music and dancing Gold with silver and incense
cards.verse_text: So I turned my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
cards.snippet: …to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.

cards.card_text: And He says how: with fasting, weeping and mourning.
cards.verse_text: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
cards.snippet: …now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”

cards.card_text: Now Jesus gets to fasting, and the warning sounds familiar: don't be somber like the hypocrites.
cards.verse_text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.
cards.snippet: …the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.

cards.verse_text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.
cards.snippet: …the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.

cards.card_text: So your fasting isn't obvious to men So you stay clean for the temple So you feel fresh while you go without
cards.verse_text: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen.

cards.card_text: Now, the disciples of John the Baptist (Mark 1:4) and the Pharisees are often fasting.
cards.verse_text: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting.
cards.snippet: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting.

cards.card_text: Anna worships night and day, fasting and praying.
cards.verse_text: She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
cards.snippet: She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

cards.card_text: While they're worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit says to set apart two of those five names for the work He has called them to.
cards.verse_text: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
